gates.requirement: Main shared-project fixture creation must include same-path common share, private files, desktop/headless and keep-id before adopt. init has no general --share and adopt does not hot-add mounts. Integrated fixture setup still needs P0 validation.
Only environment-app provider exists; host/Flatpak unified product routing requires adapter. Native GIO baselines remain independent.
Implement scoped guest-origin request/target receipt/auth/cancel before dependent subcases; no generic host shell or Podman socket. Ordinary user tasks/data writes do not depend on it.
Managed copy/move currently restricted to regular files; directory/link graph/sparse/ACL/xattr full fidelity unsupported. Native oracle and expected refusal recorded separately.
Frozen image/mount/userns/desktop contract changes require isolated fixture archive/recreate/re-registration; no delivered automatic migration/backup workflow.
Admit actual host/target before pull/create/adopt/run/pkg/ls. Same-family cases are negative checks; retain recovery and exact cleanup. Duplicate-target and concurrency contracts apply per root.
GUI cells need a real eligible desktop, devices and session created into the fixture; headless receipts do not satisfy it.
Record package digest, code root, launcher/worker/legacy/deployed entry identities and UNIFIER_HOME; v0.0.1 version text alone is insufficient.
